payload.core_mechanism_summary: Uses closed-form combinatorial formulas for binomial coefficients and derangements to directly compute the answer, summing contributions for up to k deviations.
payload.rationale: The solution code directly computes combinatorial terms using formulas for C(n,d)*D(d) without any DP state or recurrence. The DP array name is misleading; no dynamic programming is used. Hence, it is not true DP, but the problem domain involves combinatorial counting.
